description: Plan de Prevención de incendios de Sant Martí de Llémena is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by smartillemena.cat. Fire prevention plan of Sant Martí de Llémena is a set of cartographic data consisting of a plan in PDF format and an accompanying document on the plan as established in the law on measures to prevent forest fires in urbanizations, population centers, buildings and facilities located on forest land. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Fire prevention plan of Sant Martí de Llémena" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Fire prevention, Sant Martí de Llémena, Prevención de incendios, Municipality, Municipio, Prevenció d'incendis. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
